Which of the following is a disadvantage of the fixed effects approach to estimating a panel model?
Option A: The model is likely to be technical to estimate
Option B: The approach may not be valid if the composite error term is correlated with one or more of the explanatory variables
Option C: The number of parameters to estimate may be large, resulting in a loss of degrees of freedom
Option D: The fixed effects approach can only capture cross-sectional heterogeneity and not temporal variation in the dependent variable.
